CustomField.label: Available Slots
CustomField.description: Free-text open meeting slots for this prototype (e.g. "Mon 10:00-10:30 AM ET; Wed 2:00-2:30 PM ET"). Deliberately not backed by a real calendar - real availability would need the Graph Calendars.Read application permission, which hasn't been granted (see the plan's AI-agent-layer section). The AI suggestion feature reads this as plain text and echoes a slot back, it doesn't parse/validate it as real time data.
